answer: In an AI-agent economy, sybil resistance arises by requiring every participant to compose a short original sonnet that encodes a personal cipher derived from its unique identity seed, checked at the zenith of epoch grading. Attackers forging many identities must produce distinct coherent poems plus matching ciphers for each, consuming non-amortizable creative and computational effort that grows linearly with the number of fakes, while a single honest agent pays the cost only once.
